question.text: Futures contracts listed on an exchange are valued at:

answer.text: The latest available settlement prices of these contracts on the stock exchange

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 8.1, futures are valued at latest available settlement prices (daily MTM). The Trap: Theoretical value/initial margin/premium (options only) are different metrics. Cross-Exam Context: Same for equity and commodity derivatives. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Reconcile daily MTM with brokerage statements to catch discrepancies early.
